title: 第十五章 嫂子，不让你吃苦！
content_zh:
接下来是芒果树。

    灵气注入之后，芒果树的叶片从枯黄变成了油亮的深绿色，枝头挂满了沉甸甸的果实。

    那些芒果一个个长得像小木瓜似的，果皮金黄中透着一抹嫣红，像是涂了一层胭脂，光是看着就让人垂涎欲滴。

    王大壮摘了一个，剥开果皮，金黄色的果肉饱满丰盈，咬一口，浓郁的芒果香气瞬间充满整个口腔，甜度极高却不腻口，果肉细腻顺滑，几乎不需要咀嚼就在嘴里化开了。

    “绝了！”王大壮忍不住赞叹出声。

    他擦了擦额头上渗出的汗珠，看着眼前这片焕然一新的果园，心里涌起一股巨大的成就感和满足感。

    那种感觉不仅仅是因为发现了赚钱的门路，更多的是因为——他终于可以为这个家做点什么了，终于可以不再让李玉梅一个人扛着所有的重担了。

    王大壮撸起袖子，走向下一棵树。

    一棵，两棵，三棵……

    每一棵树都需要耗费灵气，而他的灵气本就微弱，每次注入之后都需要短暂地恢复。

    可他不觉得累，反而越干越起劲，因为每完成一棵树，就意味着多了一份希望，多了一份让李玉梅过上好日子的可能。

    一个多小时过去了，当王大壮把手从最后一棵橘子树干上收回的时候，整个人都有些虚脱了。

    额头、后背全是汗，衬衫湿透了贴在身上，双腿也有些发软，像是跑了一场马拉松。

    可王大壮站在那里，看着眼前的景象，所有的疲惫都烟消云散了。

    整片果园完全变了模样。

    几十棵果树郁郁葱葱，枝繁叶茂，每一棵树上都挂满了沉甸甸的果实。

    番石榴、芒果、橘子，三种水果交相辉映，在阳光下泛着诱人的光泽。

    空气里弥漫着混合的果香，浓郁得像是打翻了一整瓶香水，光是闻着就让人口水直流。

    那些果实的大小、颜色、品相，全都达到了精品水果的级别，甚至比他在超市里见过的最贵的水果还要好。

    王大壮深吸一口气，那股混合的果香灌入肺腑，让他整个人都神清气爽起来。
content_en:
Next is the mango tree.

    After the spiritual energy was injected, the leaves of the mango tree changed from withered yellow to shiny dark green, and the branches were covered with heavy fruits.

    Each of those mangoes looks like a small papaya, and the peel is golden with a hint of red, as if it has been coated with a layer of rouge. Just looking at it makes people salivate.

    Wang Dazhuang picked one and peeled off the peel. The golden flesh was plump and plump. When he took a bite, the rich mango aroma instantly filled the entire mouth. It was extremely sweet but not greasy. The flesh was so delicate and smooth that it melted in the mouth without chewing.

    "Absolutely amazing!" Wang Dazhuang couldn't help but praise.

    He wiped the sweat from his forehead and looked at the brand new orchard in front of him, feeling a huge sense of accomplishment and satisfaction in his heart.

    That feeling was not only because he had discovered a way to make money, but more because he could finally do something for the family, and finally he could no longer let Li Youmei carry all the burdens alone.

    Wang Dazhuang rolled up his sleeves and walked towards the next tree.

    One tree, two trees, three trees...

    Every tree requires the consumption of spiritual energy, and his spiritual energy is weak and needs to be restored briefly after each injection.

    But he didn't feel tired. Instead, he worked harder and harder, because every time he completed a tree, it meant more hope and more possibilities for Li Youmei to live a good life.

    More than an hour passed. When Wang Dazhuang withdrew his hand from the trunk of the last orange tree, he felt a little exhausted.

    My forehead and back were covered in sweat, my shirt was soaked and stuck to my body, and my legs were a little weak, as if I had run a marathon.

    But Wang Dazhuang stood there, looking at the scene in front of him, all his fatigue disappeared.

    The whole orchard has completely changed.

    Dozens of fruit trees are lush and green, with luxuriant branches and leaves, and each tree is covered with heavy fruits.

    Guava, mango, and orange, the three fruits complement each other and glow attractively in the sun.

    The air was filled with a mixed fruity aroma, as strong as if a whole bottle of perfume had been knocked over. Just smelling it made people's mouth water.

    The size, color, and appearance of those fruits all reached the level of fine fruits, even better than the most expensive fruits he had ever seen in the supermarket.

    Wang Dazhuang took a deep breath, and the mixed fruity aroma filled his lungs, making him feel refreshed.
title_en: Chapter 15: Sister-in-law, I won’t let you endure hardship!
